name: Customer Wars
description: With supply chain shortages, prices skyrocketing and more shoplifting than ever before, positive customer relations are nearly impossible. “Customer Wars” spotlights the conflicts that arise when disgruntled and irrational customers come face-to-face with the employees doing their best to take care of their needs. From fiery exchanges at the fast-food drive thru to loss-prevention brawls, this series proves once and for all that “The customer is always right” is the exception rather than the rule.

videos.overview: In Florida, a couple's dispute at a movie theater escalates to a call for police assistance and in Taiwan, café customers are thrown into a panic when a massive earthquake hits the area.

videos.title: Go Home or Go to Jail
videos.overview: At a North Carolina restaurant, a woman demands more hot sauce for her to go order causing some friction with the staff and other patrons and a bar fight in Washington between multiple parties requires the assistance of the authorities.

videos.title: Security Snag
videos.overview: At a Key Largo resort, officers are called to handle a couple who are allegedly causing a disturbance and at an airport in Florida, TSA agents attempt to stop a passenger who's acting erratically at a security checkpoint.

videos.title: License to Rage
videos.overview: In California, a flower shop owner livestreams a tense standoff with a customer who appears to deny a simple request.

videos.title: Train Tantrum
videos.overview: A passenger, allegedly unable to access the bathroom, causes a disturbance and a pilot calls police to deal with an unruly passenger.

videos.title: Locked In
videos.overview: In Eustis, Florida, a fast-food worker deals with an unreasonable complaint from customers and at a movie theater in Manchester, Connecticut, a dispute over assigned seating sparks a heated argument.

videos.title: Drift & Drama
videos.overview: At an event in New Jersey, a clash between a few spectators escalates into a full-blown brawl.

videos.title: Ketchup Chaos
videos.overview: On a cruise ship in Miami, Florida, a bar side dispute takes a messy turn when a woman douses a fellow passenger in ketchup.

videos.title: Chairlift of Doom
videos.overview: In Fort Lauderdale, Florida, a customer clashes with a fast-food employee over an unsatisfactory meal and at an airport in Orlando, officers step in when a disgruntled passenger is prevented from boarding her flight.

videos.title: Caught in the Act
videos.overview: In Maryville, Tennessee, a man in a wheelchair confronts two customers for blocking a handicap ramp and at a fast-food restaurant in College Park, Georgia, an employee is reportedly threatened by her ex-girlfriend who shows up.

videos.title: Not Your Lucky Day
videos.overview: At a gas station in Romeoville, Illinois, an argument breaks out when an employee refuses to cash a customer’s lottery ticket and in Palm Beach, Florida, police officers are called to a luxury hotel to deal with a disruptive guest.

videos.title: Sky High Scare
videos.overview: In San Antonio, Texas, a couple clashes with a grumpy gate agent after they are denied boarding and in Interlaken, Switzerland, a hang glider’s first flight turns into a nightmare when he realizes his harness isn’t attached.

videos.title: Card Declined
videos.overview: At a coffee shop in New York City, a conflict over a customer’s conduct escalates into a chaotic fight with an employee.

videos.title: Porch Pirate Payback
videos.overview: In Duluth, Georgia, an officer catches a customer allegedly using a borrowed police badge to get free snacks and in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, a driver jumps into her car mid-tow and tries to drive it off the lift.

videos.title: Surfer Standoff
videos.overview: Aboard a plane departing from Nashville, a man films as another passenger confronts him about their seating arrangement.

videos.title: Flightless and Furious
videos.overview: In Maryland, a delivery worker's sharp turn catches his co-worker off guard and at the Tampa airport, a passenger who's upset at missing her flight is confronted by police.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: At an amusement park, police officers confront a couple causing a disturbance.

videos.title: High Stakes Heist
videos.overview: On an airplane in Los Angeles, two friends are confronted by the flight crew.

videos.title: Iced Out
videos.overview: A woman becomes upset after hearing a group of tourists speak in their language.

videos.title: Fired Up
videos.overview: In Orlando, Florida, a tense standoff unfolds in a convenience store.

videos.title: Don't Look Up
videos.overview: At a restaurant in Texas, a melee erupts after a patron is allegedly served the wrong type of salsa.

videos.title: Room Ragers
videos.overview: At a baseball game, a confrontation between an employee and fans turns into a physical altercation.

videos.title: Clocked Out
videos.overview: At a restaurant, the police intervene because a fired employee refuses to leave the property.

videos.title: Trespass Trouble
videos.overview: In Oakland, a customer who stops the line sparks a verbal argument with other customers.

videos.title: Commuter Combat
videos.overview: A motorist brandishes a knife at a semi driver after they collide on an Albuquerque highway and police in Ohio utilize multiple PIT maneuvers during a high-speed chase.

videos.title: Birthday Blowup
videos.overview: In Enfield, Connecticut, a checkout line mess sparks a confrontation between customers and in Naples, Florida, police question a woman celebrating her birthday after she's asked to leave a restaurant following an alleged incident with an employee.

videos.title: Camp Confrontation
videos.overview: At an Oregon summer camp, an employee confronts a delivery driver, and simple questions quickly turn into a heated clash and on the Los Angeles Metro, a mysterious argument between two riders erupts into a physical brawl.

videos.title: Noise Nonsense
videos.overview: In Chappell Hill, Texas, a fast-food employee is confronted after a customer believes he was commenting on her weight and in Joliet, Illinois, an early-morning noise complaint at a gym escalates into a clash with police.

videos.title: Pizza Police
videos.overview: In a Florida neighborhood, police answering a call about an alligator loose in a neighborhood intercept a woman trying to deliver pizza to a customer. At a pro football game in L.A., trash talking between two women from opposite teams quickly turns into a massive brawl. Off the coast of a Colombian island, a couple of parasailing tourists are enjoying the view high above the ocean, when threatening winds send them on a terrifying ride.
